response_statements.document: Tether.to blog post "Tether Respond to New York Attorney General’s Actions" -- Tether's own public statement responding to the NYAG ex parte order, posted same-day per its own text ("Earlier today, the New York Attorney General’s office released an order..."); Wayback-captured 2019-04-26T02:57:29Z.
response_statements.verbatim_passage: The New York Attorney General’s court filings were written in bad faith and are riddled with false assertions, including as to a purported $850 million “loss” at Crypto Capital. On the contrary, we have been informed that these Crypto Capital amounts are not lost but have been, in fact, seized and safeguarded. We are and have been actively working to exercise our rights and remedies and get those funds released.
